{creature:Tainted Soul|Tainted Souls} roam the Tainted Caves, in the Green Claw Swamp near Venore. With a {item:Sacred Antler Talisman} that you craft yourself, you free 100 souls and earn the right to face the witch {creature:Ekatrix}. The quest resets every time you enter the boss room.
Free the Tainted Souls wandering the Green Claw Swamp from their suffering.
Does not need Premium or a minimum level (30+ recommended).
To buy the {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)|Holy Water} from {npc:Henricus} you must have reached mission 4 of {wiki:The Inquisition Quest|The Inquisition Quest}.
loot from Witches or bought from Luna in Edron
A chance to fight the boss {creature:Ekatrix} (once every 20 hours)
After freeing 100 souls with the {item:Sacred Antler Talisman}, enter the {item:Mystic Flame} on the 4th floor of the {wiki:Tainted Caves}.
Once every 20 hours; the quest resets every time you enter the boss room.
You can also free the Tainted Souls' summons: lure two Tainted Souls to you and free their summons. That way you get the 100 souls in under 10 minutes.
You do not need to kill the {creature:Redeemed Soul|Redeemed Souls}: they disappear on their own 30 seconds after appearing.

Get the three ingredients: {item:Antlers} (loot from {creature:Deer}), a {item:Star Herb} (loot from {creature:Witch|Witches} or bought from {npc:Luna} in Edron) and a {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)|Holy Water} (bought from {npc:Henricus} in Thais, after you reach mission 4 of {wiki:The Inquisition Quest|The Inquisition Quest}).
Use the {item:Star Herb} on the {item:Antlers}. You receive an {item:Antler Talisman} and the message *"You entwine the antler with fresh star herb."*

Use the {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)|Holy Water} on the {item:Antler Talisman}. You receive the {item:Sacred Antler Talisman} and the message *"You besprinkle the antler talisman with holy water. It glitters faintly."*

Take the {item:Sacred Antler Talisman} to the {wiki:Tainted Caves|Tainted Caves}, in the **north** of the Green Claw Swamp. The cave has 4 floors, all with the same monsters. To get there: go to **Venore** (by boat, {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}), leave through the **southwest** exit and follow the road **northwest**, towards the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}. The entrance to the {wiki:Tainted Caves} is in the north of the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp}, not far away, **northeast** of the Dwarf Bridge.
You will meet {creature:Tainted Soul|Tainted Souls}, {creature:Toad|Toads}, {creature:Gloom Wolf|Gloom Wolves} and {creature:Witch|Witches}.
Using the talisman on the souls

Explore the cave and use the {item:Sacred Antler Talisman} on every {creature:Tainted Soul|Tainted Soul} you find, until you have freed **100 souls**. For each soul freed a {creature:Redeemed Soul} appears and the Tainted Soul disappears shortly after. The Tainted Souls' summons also count.

If you want to complete the {wiki:Bestiary|Bestiary}: you have 30 seconds to kill each Redeemed Soul and a single turn to kill the Tainted Soul after using the talisman on it. If there is no room around you, the Redeemed Soul may not appear, but the soul still counts.
With the 100 souls freed, go down to the **4th floor** of the cave and step into the {item:Mystic Flame}. You are teleported to a nearby room with {creature:Ekatrix}.
As soon as you enter the boss room, the quest resets: to fight again you have to free another 100 souls.
Kill {creature:Ekatrix}. You can only kill her once every **20 hours**.

After Ekatrix, leave the boss room and climb the 4 floors of the cave through the same spots you came down, up to the entrance in the Green Claw Swamp. From there head back **southeast** along the road to Venore's southwest exit.
This quest appears in the quest log under {wiki:Adventurers Guild (Quest)|Adventurers Guild}.
